items.title: Nearly 200 experts meet in Bangkok to advance IPCC assessment of climate change mitigation
items.description: PATHUM, Sept 28 – Nearly 200 authors from 79 countries are gathered at the Asian Institute of Technology in Pathum, Thailand, from 28 September to 1 October to draft the Working Group III contribution to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Seventh Assessment Report (AR7) on the mitigation of climate change. items.title: Diesel prices are surging putting further pressure on Europe
items.description: Trucks, farms and industry are powered with diesel. Now prices are soaring due to refinery disruptions, supply shortages and geopolitical tensions. A potential US export ban could make Europe's diesel crunch even worse.
